personality_one_liner: A calm, highly readable, and trustworthy file manager that lets the content breathe through generous spacing and subtle earthy sage accents.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS native padding, use xl (24) around screen edges and md (12) or lg (16) between stacked components.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard showing storage usage overview and quick access to recent files and categories.

states.empty: No recent files state with an illustration and a prompt to upload your first file.
states.error: Failed to load storage data message with a primary Retry button.

screens.layout: 1. Storage Usage Card at top (glass overlaid on paper texture background) showing GB used/total. 2. 2-column grid of Categories (Documents, Images, Videos, Other) using brandTertiary tinted icons. 3. 'Recent Files' vertical list with leading file-type icons. A Sticky FAB in bottom right corner for 'Upload'.

screens.name: Files (Browse)
screens.purpose: A dedicated tab to navigate the full file tree and search/filter.

states.empty: Empty state photo (white box) with text 'Your drive is empty' and a primary Upload CTA.
states.error: Error message 'Unable to fetch files' with retry.

screens.layout: Sticky Header with Search input (surfaceTertiary) and Filter chips below it. Vertical list of files/folders. Each list item has a leading icon (in brandTertiary bg circle), title, subtitle (date/size), and trailing 3-dot menu. Use dividers between rows.

screens.name: Upload Modal (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: Action sheet triggered by the FAB to select file type (Image, Video, Document).

states.loading: Uploading progress bar state inside the sheet.

screens.layout: Half-screen bottom sheet with frosted glass header and drag handle. List of upload options (Camera, Photo Library, Files) using large row height (56pt) and brandTertiary icons.

screens.name: File Details
screens.purpose: Preview the selected file and provide management actions.

states.error: Preview not available placeholder with a broken link icon.

screens.layout: Top half is the file preview (image/video viewer). If no preview, large file type icon on surfaceSecondary background. Below preview: Large file name, detailed metadata (size, created date, type). Bottom sticky container with primary actions (Share, Rename, Delete). Delete should be semantic (error color).

storage_card_bg.alt: Abstract subtle paper texture for storage card background

empty_folder.alt: Clean white open box indicating empty state

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 1 iOS-Native Clean personality. Keep backgrounds light and padding generous (xl).
Do NOT use any blue/indigo/purple colors. Rely entirely on the provided Sage Green and earthy tones.
Implement a sticky Floating Action Button (FAB) for the Upload action on the Home and Files tabs, with a glass effect and brandPrimary tint.
For the top Storage Usage card on the Home screen, use the 'storage_card_bg' image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceSecondary) to ensure text readability.
For File items in the list, use a rounded icon container with 'brandTertiary' background and 'brandPrimary' icon instead of bare icons.
Ensure all primary CTAs are sticky at the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView and safe area padding.
Use Phosphor icons consistently (one weight per screen, typically regular or thin for iOS feel).
Use `expo-glass-effect` for the bottom tabs and the sticky search header in the Files screen.
Always wire up the exact haptics events mentioned in the 'haptics' block.

Based on research: Storage dashboard apps need immediate glanceability of used capacity, prominently displayed recent files, and a very quick path to upload (hence the sticky FAB over standard inline buttons).
